title: Existence of Traveling Waves for a Diffusive Nicholson Equation with Harvesting
summary: We prove the existence of traveling wave solutions for a diffusive Nicholson model with a delayed linear harvesting term and two delayed-response channels. Our approach combines monotone heteroclinic connections of the associated scalar delay equation with the large-speed traveling-wave theorem of Faria, Huang and Wu. For \(0<σ<r\), we use a previous upper- and lower-solution construction under an explicit parameter condition. For \(0<r\leqσ\), we establish a new monotone heteroclinic connection.
